generated/p01_messages.note: 120,120 messages over 50,960 lifecycles, every one packed and re-parsed by the product's own codec before it was written. No public corpus of real card traffic exists, and for PCI reasons there will not be one.
generated/p01_messages.role_means: rows a measurement reports a rate over; has to hold between 50,000 and 1,000,000 of them

generated/p03_utterances.note: 200,000 labelled utterances. The gold label comes from how each sentence was composed, and the spellings are the ones attested in 37,220 real Roman Urdu sentences.
generated/p03_utterances.role_means: rows a measurement reports a rate over; has to hold between 50,000 and 1,000,000 of them

generated/p04_tasks.note: 60,000 wire tasks drawn from the ISO 8583 corpus, 15,000 of each family. The answers come from the corpus, so project 01's codec can be scored on every one of them rather than on the 29 the model is asked.
generated/p04_tasks.role_means: rows a measurement reports a rate over; has to hold between 50,000 and 1,000,000 of them

generated/p05_policies.note: 60,000 credit policies sampled from the DSL grammar, each one written out in prose and in policy text. Doubles as a grammar fuzzer: every one is compiled, reprinted and compiled again.
generated/p05_policies.role_means: rows a measurement reports a rate over; has to hold between 50,000 and 1,000,000 of them

real/card_applications.note: Real card applications. Only 8.3% join to a repayment history, so the whole book is scored with every outcome figure withheld.
real/card_applications.role_means: rows a measurement reports a rate over; has to hold between 50,000 and 1,000,000 of them

real/card_credit_records.note: Monthly repayment status per account. Two definitions of bad - ever 30+ and ever 60+ days past due - disagree by nearly seven times on the same rows. A lookup table, not a cohort: nothing reports a rate over these rows.
real/card_credit_records.role_means: a table another dataset is joined against, such as a repayment history keyed by account; counted and fingerprinted, but no size policy

real/loan_book.note: Real loan applications with the outcome that happened: 29,653 defaults, a base rate of 11.61%. The one file here whose backtest is not circular.
real/loan_book.role_means: rows a measurement reports a rate over; has to hold between 50,000 and 1,000,000 of them
